questions.question: The total number of candidates that qualified from all the states together in 1998 is approximately what percentage of the total number of candidates that qualified from all the states together in 2001? (Correct to Two decimal points)
questions.solution:
Total number of candidates that qualified from all the States together in 1998 = 980 + 1050 + 1020 + 1240 = 4290

Total number of candidates that qualified from all the Stages together in 2001 = 1125 + 1020 + 1250 + 995 = 4390

Required percentage = 4290/4390 × 100 = 97.72%

The length, breadth and height of a cuboidal box are in the ratio 7 : 5 : 3 and its whole surface area is 27832 cm². Its volume is.
questions.solution:
As we know,

Total surface area of cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl)

Ratio of length, breadth and height of cuboidal box = 7x : 5x : 3x

Total surface are of cuboidal box = 2(lb + bh + hl)

2 (7x × 5x + 5x × 3x + 3x × 7x) = 27832

⇒ (35x² + 15x² + 21x²) = 27832/2

⇒ 71x² = 13916

⇒ x² = 13916/71 = 196

⇒ x = √196

⇒ x = 14

∴ Volume of the cuboidal box = lbh = 7x × 5x × 3x = 105 × 14 × 14 × 14 = 288120

**__Short Trick__****:**

As we know, length is multiple of 7, then answer is divisible by 7, only option 288120 is divisible by 7.

questions.question: If 3A = 4B = 5C, then A : B : C is equal to:
questions.solution:
3A = 4B = 5C

Let, 3A = 4B = 5C = K

3A = k

A = k/3

Similarly,

B = k/4 and C = k/5

Ratio of A, B and C = k/3 : k/4 : k/5 = 60/3 : 60/4 : 60/5 = 20 : 15 : 12

**__Short trick__****:**

If 3A = 4B = 5C, then

A : B : C = 1/3 : 1/4 : 1/5 = 20 : 15 : 12

questions.question: X and Y are two stations that are 280 km apart. A train starts at a certain time from X and travels towards Y at 60 km/h. After 2 hours, another train starts from Y and travels towards X at 20 km/h After how many hours does the train leaving from X meet the train which left from Y?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance between X and Y is 280km

Speed of the first train = 60 km/hr

Speed of second train = 20 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculation:**

Distance covered by first train in 2 hr = 60 × 2 = 120 km

Remaining distance = 280 - 120 = 160 km

Relative speed, if opposite direction = 60 + 20 = 80 km/hr

Time when both train meet = 160/80 = 2 hr

Total time when they meet = 2 hr + 2 hr =** 4 hr**

questions.question: The single discount equivalent to two successive discounts of 20% and 15% is:
questions.solution:
**Short Trick:**

Single equivalent discount of 20% and 15% = 20 + 15 - [(20 × 15)/100] = 35 - 3 = 32%

**Detailed Method:**

Let number be 100 unit

Number after two successive discount = 100 × (80/100) × (85/100) = 68

Number decreased by = 100 - 68 = 32

Number decreased by in % = 32/100 × 100 = 32%

questions.question: Ram makes a profit of 30% by selling an article. What would be the profit percent if it were calculated on the selling price instead of the cost price? (correct to one decimal place)
questions.solution:
30% = 3/10

Let CP = 10 and SP = 13

Profit = 13 - 10 = 3

Profit % if profit calculated on selling price = 3/13 × 100 ≈ 23.1%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Calculation:** 

Let the C.P be 100

Now, 30% profit 

S.P = 130

According to the question,

Profit = 130 - 100 = 30

compare to the S.P

⇒ (30/130)× 100

⇒ 300/13

⇒ 23.07% ≈ 23.1%

**∴ The profit percentage is 23.1%.**

questions.question: Ravi scores 72% marks in examinations. If these are 360 marks, the maximum marks are:
questions.solution:
Let maximum marks be x, then

x × (72/100) = 360

⇒ x = 360 × (100/72)

⇒ x = 500

So, the maximum marks is 500.

__**Short Trick:**__

Let maximum marks be 100%

72% = 360

⇒ 100% = 360 × (100/72) = 500

questions.question: The average age of A, B and C is 20 years, and that of B and C is 25 years. What is the age of A?
questions.solution:
Average age of A, B and C = 20

Sum of age of A, B and C = 20 × 3 = 60

Average age of B and C = 25

Sum of age of B and C = 25 × 2 = 50

Age of A = 60 - 50 = 10 years

questions.question: What is the area of a sector of a circle of radius 14 cm and central angle 45°?(Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius of sector (r) = 14 cm

Central angle (θ) = 45° 

**Formula Used:**

Area of sector = πr² × (θ/360)

**Calculation:**

Area of sector

= (22/7) × 14 × 14 × (45°/360°)

= 77 cm²

**∴ Required area of the sector is 77 cm²**
